Subject: Supplier master onboarding: legal identity, remit address, PO/billing contacts

Hi Elena,

Thanks for taking the call today. To get Ascenta into our vendor master and enable PO creation, we need the following items so Finance can complete setup:

- Legal entity name (as registered)
- Federal tax ID / VAT (country dependent)
- Remit/invoice address (line 1, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Billing / PO contact name, email, and phone
- ACH/wiring beneficiary name, bank name, account number (or a bank letter)
- DUNS or company registration number (if available)
- W9 or equivalent tax form (PDF preferred)

I've attached our vendor intake form link here for completion: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C

If you can reply with the fields above and attach the W9 + bank proof, we can create a draft payee record and issue the first PO. Our target is to have this completed by EOD Monday.

Thanks,

David Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
